about: Experience Resident Evil 2 originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Two months after the Mansion Incident in the Arklay Mountains near Raccoon City, rookie police officer Leon S. Kennedy is about to start his first day on the force. Meanwhile, Claire Redfield heads into town to track down her missing brother, Chris. Leon and Claire couldn't possibly predict the horrors that await them...

This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
summary: Experience Resident Evil 2 originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
